"US" is a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head, which never fuses per Names and casing - expected the head noun typed on its own plus (Possession <group> us) and a (Name us "US") fact - yet the parse fuses us_researcher and emits no Name atom for the US.

a proportional quantifier inside a seal - a sealed rule carries no STV, so "nearly one in 10" survives only as the QuantifierPhrase word and the ~0.1 strength has no carrier
